Glowing parts (orange sacs, seams) are painted at their glowing colour, not as light cast on their surroundings. No glow outside the silhouette. No added chains, drapery, spikes or ornaments absent from the guide. No text.
Critical checks: identical silhouette to guide; design-reference materials and colours; flat even lighting; true transparent background.
